description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mercurial Pretender that has haste. Choose to have Mercurial Pretender enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Mercurial Pretender token instead.
